verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents stablecoin-powered cross-border payments that settle "in minutes" rather than 24-48 hours via SWIFT, available 24/7 across 190+ countries. One page says payments can settle "as fast as seconds," but in the context of FX conversion between Jeeves Cash accounts, and standard global payments are only promised "as soon as the same day." Missing for 10: an explicit sub-minute arrival guarantee for outbound international transfers, any independent or hands-on timing evidence, and clarity on which corridors or rails achieve near-instant delivery.
